QuoteParams.title: QuoteParams
QuoteParams.description:
The tokens to quote in, and the call: whole (`call`), or only its data's length
(`callDataLength`), both if they agree; its gas, estimated if not given (only for a call
given whole); its EIP-7702 authorizations, signed (`authorizationList`), or the account
that will sign one (`authority`); `payer`, the account a signed transfer pays from, if one
pays (without it, the call pays for itself), and the gas its signature check takes, if
known, only with it; and an account to deploy first, if any. A submission's fields, less
its payment and deadline.

AuthorizationJson.title: AuthorizationJson
AuthorizationJson.description:
An EIP-7702 authorization, as in a type-4 transaction's JSON (its signature's numbers
padded or not).

DeploymentJson.title: DeploymentJson
DeploymentJson.description:
An account to deploy before the call, if it has no code: `factory` called with
`factoryData` (ERC-4337's names).

QuoteResult.title: QuoteResult
QuoteResult.description:
A quote in each token, valid until `validUntilBlock`, and the gas the call is priced
for, to sign as the submission's.

TokenQuote.title: TokenQuote
TokenQuote.description:
A quote in `token`, broken down, and with the transfer its payer signs, if one pays
(`typedData`).

BreakdownJson.title: BreakdownJson
BreakdownJson.description:
A call's quote in parts, for people to read: its account's setup, the call, the
payment's transfer and check, and the relay's own, the rest; they sum to the amount.

TransferTypedData.title: TransferTypedData
TransferTypedData.description:
A transfer for its payer to sign, as EIP-712's JSON (eth_signTypedData_v4's) writes it:
signed as it is, it's the payment.

TransferMessage.title: TransferMessage
TransferMessage.description:
A transferWithAuthorization's fields, its numbers as decimal strings, as EIP-712's JSON
writes them.

SendParams.title: SendParams
SendParams.description: A submission: a call, its gas and its payment.

TransferJson.title: TransferJson
TransferJson.description:
A payment's EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, signed: of the payment's amount, from
`from` to its payee.

signature.description: A signature, as hex: a key's 65 bytes, a contract's, or ERC-6492-wrapped

SponsorshipQuoteParams.title: SponsorshipQuoteParams
SponsorshipQuoteParams.description:
A sponsorship to quote, and the tokens to quote it in: the `account` sponsored; its own
transactions, each signed already (its raw bytes) or still to be (an object); its EIP-7702
authorizations, signed, and the call the relay's first transaction makes into it, that
call's gas estimated if not given; and its deadline, the furthest one if not given.

UnsignedTransactionJson.title: UnsignedTransactionJson
UnsignedTransactionJson.description:
A transaction the sponsored account is to sign, as a sponsorship's quote is asked about
it: its gas estimated if not given, its nonce and fees the quote's to fill in; no `to` for
a contract creation.

SponsorshipQuoteResult.title: SponsorshipQuoteResult
SponsorshipQuoteResult.description:
A sponsorship's quote in each token, valid until `validUntilBlock`: its deadline
(`maxBlockNumber`), the forwarder it pays, the gas the relay's first transaction's call is
given (if the account's code runs in it), and each of its transactions as filled in to
sign, null for one signed already.

ToSignJson.title: ToSignJson
ToSignJson.description:
A transaction filled in for its account to sign (EIP-1559's, type 2), as a wallet takes
it: no `to` for a contract creation.

SponsorshipTokenQuote.title: SponsorshipTokenQuote
SponsorshipTokenQuote.description:
What a sponsorship is charged in `token`, and the payment of it its account signs after
its own transactions, if it has any (`payment`).

SponsorshipParams.title: SponsorshipParams
SponsorshipParams.description:
A sponsorship: the `account` sponsored; its own transactions, each signed, as its raw
bytes; its EIP-7702 authorizations, signed, and the call the relay's first transaction
makes into it, with that call's gas; its payment, to the forwarder; and its deadline.

SponsorshipPaymentJson.title: SponsorshipPaymentJson
SponsorshipPaymentJson.description: A sponsorship's payment: at least `amount` of `token`, to the forwarder at `payee`.

Rejection.title: Rejection
Rejection.description:
Why a submission was rejected, its status' reason: outbid from a full queue, no longer
simulating, a transaction of it reverted on-chain, or its bundle broken: some of its
transactions landed without the rest, which a builder was to land whole or not at all.

UserOperationJson.title: UserOperationJson
UserOperationJson.description:
ERC-7769's UserOperation: its account, nonce, factory and data while it's undeployed (an
EIP-7702 account's factory 0x7702), call data, gas limits (not read to estimate it), fees
(zero if its calls pay the relay), signature (the account's stub, to estimate it), and the
account's EIP-7702 authorization if it brings one; and its paymaster's, if it has one: its
address, its data, and its limits (left to the estimate if the client doesn't give them).

anyOf.description: An address, or 0x7702: an EIP-7702 account (EntryPoint v0.8)

GasEstimateResult.title: GasEstimateResult
GasEstimateResult.description:
eth_estimateUserOperationGas's answer: the op's gas limits, its paymaster's too if it
has one.

UserOperationReceiptJson.title: UserOperationReceiptJson
UserOperationReceiptJson.description:
ERC-7769's receipt of an op: its UserOperationEvent's fields, the logs its execution
emitted, and its transaction's receipt, both as the node gave them.

GasPriceResult.title: GasPriceResult
GasPriceResult.description:
pimlico_getUserOperationGasPrice's and zd_getUserOperationGasPrice's answer: the price an
op paying by its fees is asked, as both its fees, at each speed alike (the relay sends each
op to every builder each block, at one price).

GasPrice.title: GasPrice
GasPrice.description: An op's two fees, as a bundler's gas price methods give them.

UNDERPAID.message: Underpaid at the next block's price

NO_CAPACITY.message: No capacity: the queue is full of more profitable submissions

UNAVAILABLE.message: Unavailable: try again, or only the operator can fix it, as data says
